title: ✨ New In Raycast AI
summary: View what's new in Raycast v2.3
body_markdown:
[v2.3](https://www.raycast.com/changelog/macos/2-3) September 11, 2026


We rebuilt the core of Raycast AI. You can now give AI Chat a task and it works out a plan, uses your extensions, writes and runs code, checks the results, and keeps going until it's finished. When something fails, it tries a different approach. And when it needs a decision from you, it stops, asks you, and then continues where it left off.


Tasks like these cost more to run than a single question, which is why this release also changes how we charge for AI. Our plans move from rate-limited to usage-based, all subscription prices stay the same, and there's a new Max plan for heavier usage.[Read the full reasoning on our blog](https://www.raycast.com/blog/changing-how-raycast-ai-is-priced) .


But there is more…


### 🔁 Bring Your Own Subscriptions


You can now connect your Claude or ChatGPT account to any paid Raycast plan and use those models in AI Chat, Quick AI, and AI Commands. This lets you run the heaviest tasks without worrying about additional costs. We plan to add other providers in the future, turning AI Chat into your single interface to get the most out of your subscriptions. You can enable models from your subscriptions in *Settings → AI → Models & Providers.*


### 📁 Projects


Projects keep conversations about the same topic together. They have their own memory, so you don't have to explain yourself every time you start a new chat, and the agent builds on decisions you've already made. You can also give a project a working directory. Point it at an Obsidian vault, a folder of invoices, or any other folder on your Mac or PC, and the agent knows where to work with your files.


### 🤖 Automations


Automations run prompts on a schedule, so you don't have to start the same task yourself every time. The agent works in the background and adds the result to a chat. Our team uses them to triage their email inboxes every morning, babysit open pull requests every hour, and update Raycast’s memory from their meeting notes every evening.


## ✨ New


- **AI** : Added support for rendering Mermaid diagrams
- **AI** : Added Auto-review rules for greater control over how Auto mode behaves
- **AI:** Press ⌘ + F to find text in chat
- **AI** : Deleted chats now land in *Recently Deleted* , where you can restore them before they're permanently removed after a retention window of 60 days


## 💎 Improvements


- **AI** : Raycast now prevents your computer from sleeping while AI is running
- **AI** : Auto mode now handles routine local work with fewer unnecessary interruptions
- **AI** : Tool approval prompts now clearly explain the requested action and its impact, making them easier to review before continuing
- **AI** : Tool confirmations now default to Auto, so sessions no longer ask for permission on every tool call if you never touched the setting
- **AI:** Searching chats will now include content hits
- **AI** : Search the` /` model menu and` @` mention menu by provider, so typing` /ollama` or` /openai` finds the matching models
- **AI:** Model picker now show your recently used models
- **AI:**` @` mention menu will now order options based on frecency
- **Clipboard History:** Add missing *Share* option to Clipboard History entries
- **Clipboard History:** Added AI tools to search entries by text, title, or text found in images, and to filter by type
- **Clipboard History:** Added AI tools to open a specific entry and rewrite its contents, with a confirmation step before anything is replaced
- **Extensions** : Improved performance when displaying large extension views
- **File Search:** Directories automatically excluded from indexing due to significant churn can now be *permanently* re-included via File Search Settings
- **File Search:** Exact term matches should now rank higher in results
- **MCP** : Added Reset Sign In so you can retry an incomplete sign-in without reinstalling the server
- **Root Search:** Added support for Finder aliases to applications, including aliases to apps outside your search scopes
- **Root Search:** Applications on external drives now appear as soon as the drive is mounted and are removed when it's ejected, instead of only after restarting Raycast
- **Root Search:** Internal helper apps no longer appear temporarily after an application is installed, including helpers bundled inside linked applications
- **Root Search:** Add missing Share option for files in root search
- **Script Commands** : Added support for using scripts with a text argument as fallback commands
- **UI** : Ensured macOS text replacements work across all editing surfaces


## 🐞 Fixes


- **AI Chat** : Fixed tool calls silently losing their arguments when streamed from a custom provider in certain cases
- **AI Chat** : Fixed *Always on Top* falling out of sync with the saved preference after reopening the window
- **AI Local Models** : Ollama connections no longer go through the system proxy, fixing repeated connection failures and a probe loop for people running a proxy
- **Calculator History** : Fixed an issue where some calculations would appear to truncate too eagerly in the list view
- **Calculator** : Fixed missing results for “now”, “time”, “today”, “tomorrow”, and “yesterday”
- **Calculator** : Fixed unnecessary results appearing when entering plain numbers
- **Clipboard History:** Fixed clipboard capture silently stopping mid-session, which required restarting Raycast to start recording copies again
- **Define Word:** Fixed a crash while typing in Define Word, most often reproducible with non-English input
- **Extensions** : Fixed an issue with form label/control alignment
- **Extensions** : Updated outdated AI models used by extensions and fixed creativity settings being ignored
- **Extensions** : Fixed getting stuck on the success screen after forking an extension
- **Hotkeys:** Fixed an application hotkey raising only the last-focused window instead of all of the app's windows when a Raycast window was active
- **Importer:** Fixed older Hyper Key preferences blocking the migration of general settings and the launcher hotkey
- **MCP** : Fixed sign-in failures with some servers, including Tripsy
- **Raycast Focus:** Fixed the Ask Raycast Focus command not resolving from Root Search
- **Root Search** : Fixed an issue where the action panel could sometimes reopen when navigating back to Root Search
- **Screenshots** : Fixed recognizing screenshots and screen recordings with localized filenames
- **Store** : Fixed installing extensions after choosing to ignore platform restrictions, and updating those extensions afterward
- **Store** : Fixed cut-off extension details on the installation screen
